ops.title: Snapshot fact cache follow-ups: oversized entries, real-fact accounting, warm_root retention
ops.description:
Open items from the 2026-10-10 fact-cache work, none blocking:

- A prepared entry larger than one whole warm step (8 MiB on the host) is refused with `source_limit` and the registered members after it are not warmed by that job. The largest live entry measured 1,727,664 bytes, so it does not occur today. The alternative is resumable chunked verification, which also needs the consumer to count `prepared_cache_bytes_read` as progress.
- Built-versus-decoded accounting was 1.44x in the tiny regression fixture and 1.0008x in the actual-scale synthetic replay. It has not been measured on real facts.
- `warm_root` relies on the root snapshot staying retained between a deferred step and the next; under retention pressure that drops it every step, the source is re-read each time.
- `tests/test_snapshot_review_consumers.py::test_review_preparation_refuses_a_candidate_over_the_owned_page_by_size` was deselected in the local paired run because an unoptimized candidate build hit the host resource monitor; CI ran it green on PR #352.

ops.text: Each listed item is either fixed with a test or closed with a recorded reason
